title: Random Choice Picker
description: Pick random items, names, or winners from a list of choices online instantly. Set pick quantity and duplicates toggle.

faqs.question: How do I input my choices?
faqs.answer: Simply type or paste your choices in the input text area, entering one choice per line.

faqs.question: Is the picker completely fair?
faqs.answer: Yes. It uses the Web Crypto API (`window.crypto.getRandomValues`) to select items randomly, ensuring unbiased selection.

educationalContent.whatIsIt: A Random Choice Picker selects one or more items out of a list of custom inputs, ideal for raffles, deciding what to eat, drawing winners, or making neutral decisions.
educationalContent.howToUse:
1. Enter your options in the input box, one per line.
2. Choose how many items to pick.
3. Decide if you want to allow duplicate picks.
4. Click "Pick Winner" to run the selection.
